title: LCARS Events Catalogue
description: Structural schema for priv/event_router/events.yaml (parsed YAML map). Exercised BOTH by events_schema_test.exs (build-time structural gate) AND by the runtime loader (Fleet.EventRouter.Catalog.load!/0) since the registry became load-bearing for ROUTING: an entry's value is either [] (unrouted - consumed by direct subscribers, documented per consumer moduledoc) or a routing object driving the incident classification (IncidentConsumer). The old tolerance for a non-empty handler-module list is GONE (audit B-05).

events.description: Map event_type -> [] (unrouted) OR routing object {source, action, incident?}. The routing is the declarative event+source -> classification/action table loaded at boot.

oneOf.description: Unrouted: consumed by direct PubSub subscribers (see the consumers' moduledocs).

source.description: REQUIRED producer source (anti-spoof): the chain acts only on events carrying this source - a spoofed-source event of the type is ignored.

action.description: incident = incident recording/escalation via IncidentConsumer (requires the incident block; the block's `gate` field picks the door: immediate | recurrence).

incident.description: Incident classification (action=incident only): op = the registry operation class (dedup namespace), subject = the payload key carrying the incident subject, escalate_kind = typed escalation override, forward = extra payload keys forwarded as diagnostic opts.

gate.description: The gate: immediate = durable issue on the FIRST occurrence (escalate_gated, cooldown only); recurrence (default) = first noted, recurrence escalated (record_or_escalate). immediate REQUIRES escalate_kind (closed kind table in Escalation - an unnamed kind crashes; refused at boot by the Catalog).
